claims.subject: Martin Müller / Müller Fleisch GmbH
claims.claim: The Verband der Fleischwirtschaft currently lists Martin Müller of Müller Fleisch GmbH as its board chair.
claims.boundary: A company-linked executive's association role does not mean Müller Fleisch authored, controlled or agreed with every VDF position or caused a policy outcome.
claims.falsification_condition: A current VDF governance record changes the office-holder or affiliation.

claims.subject: DMK Deutsches Milchkontor GmbH
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister reports annual lobbying expenditure of €220,001 to €230,000 for DMK Deutsches Milchkontor GmbH in financial year 2025.
claims.boundary: Lobbying expenditure does not prove policy influence, improper conduct or expenditure by the whole Arla group.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official register version changes the financial period or expenditure range.

claims.subject: DMK Deutsches Milchkontor GmbH
claims.claim: The current Bundestag Lobbyregister entry for DMK lists two concrete regulatory initiatives: possible expansion of Tierhaltungskennzeichnung to dairy products and implementation of mandatory first-purchase contracts for raw milk under agricultural supply-chain rules.
claims.boundary: A registered objective proves declared advocacy activity, not that a law changed because of DMK or that Arla adopted the same position after integration.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected or superseding official register record changes the initiatives or attribution.

claims.subject: DMK Deutsches Milchkontor GmbH
claims.claim: The Bundestag Lobbyregister states that DMK Deutsches Milchkontor GmbH received no public grants or subsidies above €10,000 in financial year 2025.
claims.boundary: This narrow negative claim applies only to DMK Deutsches Milchkontor GmbH, the stated period and register threshold; it must not be generalized to subsidiaries, cooperatives, Arla or other support schemes.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected register record or authoritative recipient-level source shows a qualifying grant for this entity and period.

claims.subject: Bundeskartellamt / DMK raw-milk supply conditions
claims.claim: In 2018 the Bundeskartellamt announced that it had discontinued a sample proceeding concerning DMK raw-milk supply conditions after changes including a reduction of DMK's notice period from 24 to 12 months.
claims.source_title: Bundeskartellamt — Proceeding against DMK dairy discontinued
claims.boundary: The proceeding concerned competition/supply conditions, not an animal-welfare violation or criminal finding; it was discontinued.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected official Bundeskartellamt record materially changes the procedural outcome or described conditions.

claims.subject: Hochwald Foods GmbH
claims.claim: Hochwald states that in March 2023 the Bundeskartellamt cleared its acquisition of the Tuffi brand; Hochwald also acquired a production licence for Landliebe rice-pudding products.
claims.boundary: This is acquisition/competition history, not an animal-welfare enforcement finding; the source is Hochwald's account of the clearance.
claims.falsification_condition: An authoritative competition or corporate record materially corrects the acquisition or licence status.

claims.subject: Plukon Brenz GmbH and Plukon Gudensberg GmbH
claims.claim: A historical Bundestag Lobbyregister entry for IDEG listed Plukon Brenz GmbH and Plukon Gudensberg GmbH among IDEG's clients/auftraggeber.
claims.source_title: Deutscher Bundestag Lobbyregister — former IDEG entry R004579
claims.boundary: IDEG is marked as a former lobbyist since 2023; the historical client relationship does not establish current Plukon lobbying or agreement with every IDEG position.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected historical register version removes or changes the Plukon entities' listed relationship.

claims.subject: Celler Land Frischgeflügel and Emsland Frischgeflügel
claims.claim: A historical Bundestag Lobbyregister entry for IDEG listed Rothkötter-linked Celler Land Frischgeflügel GmbH & Co. KG and Emsland Frischgeflügel GmbH among IDEG's clients/auftraggeber.
claims.source_title: Deutscher Bundestag Lobbyregister — former IDEG entry R004579
claims.boundary: This is historical and association-linked; it does not establish current direct lobbying by the Rothkötter group or agreement with every IDEG position.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected historical register version changes the listed client relationships.

claims.subject: Gräfendorfer Geflügel- und Tiefkühlfeinkost Produktions GmbH
claims.claim: A historical Bundestag Lobbyregister entry for IDEG listed Sprehe-linked Gräfendorfer Geflügel- und Tiefkühlfeinkost Produktions GmbH among IDEG's clients/auftraggeber.
claims.source_title: Deutscher Bundestag Lobbyregister — former IDEG entry R004579
claims.boundary: This historical relationship does not prove current direct Sprehe lobbying, current IDEG activity or agreement with every position attributed to IDEG.
claims.falsification_condition: A corrected historical register version changes the Gräfendorfer relationship.
